engine_notes: Phoneme-level CTC (blank=PAD=0) over a 48-token phoneme inventory. Android must implement (a) G2P to phonemes, (b) the char<->phoneme mapper (ja_pronunciation.py / map_spans_to_char_units), (c) CTC Viterbi. The model itself has NO baked normalisation.

Upstream copyright remains with the original authors; see NOTICE.md. No endorsement by the upstream authors is implied.

input.name: input_values
input.preprocessing: raw 16k mono PCM in [-1,1]; NO external normalization (preprocessor do_normalize=false; HuBERT uses internal group norm)

text.normalization: NFKC -> pyopenjtalk G2P to phonemes (Latin is read letter-by-letter); see g2p_dependency

accuracy.gate_result: 3 of 15 gate rows failed; one further reference row is non-gate (see android_export/ja/REPORT.md)
accuracy.notes: Same-methodology PyTorch-vs-FP32 baseline is 0.00 ms, so the 147 ms is purely a quantisation effect. Japanese remains EXPERIMENTAL: the acoustic model is trained on read speech.

g2p_dependency.recommended: bundle OpenJTalk + NAIST dictionary and call it via JNI
g2p_dependency.openjtalk_code_license: MIT (pyopenjtalk); modified BSD (NAIST) for the dictionary
g2p_dependency.note: The dictionary is NOT part of this pack. If Android bundles it, it must reproduce the NAIST copyright notice and disclaimer. The HTS voice (mei_normal.htsvoice) is synthesis-only and must not be shipped for G2P.
